summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 30 October 2026 carrying a Regulatory News Service announcement on Total Voting Rights and Capital, the routine monthly denominator disclosure UK issuers publish under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. The filing states 57,262,647,007 ordinary shares of 10p each carry voting rights, inclusive of shares represented by American Depositary Receipts, with no shares held in treasury. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation or advisor is referenced. The figure serves only as a denominator for interest-notification calculations; no deal or risk-arb angle arises.
